verdict.rationale: CDP documents a first-party webhooks product that sends real-time HTTP notifications for events across an integration. It also documents subscriptions, including `wallet.activity.multi`, which can watch up to 100 wallet addresses under one subscription. That covers the core of subscribing to events via webhooks. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of payment-specific event types, details on delivery reliability, retries and signature verification, any evidence of managing subscriptions programmatically or agentically, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
